rationale: Motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and injury to the policyholder; a textbook auto claim.
claim_summary: Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15 am; the vehicle is totaled with severe trunk/rear damage. Policyholder sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist. Police report filed with other driver's insurance information. This is a high-severity claim requiring prompt vehicle inspection and medical documentation.

case_facts.description: rear-end collision; other vehicle traveling at ~35 mph with no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; entire trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.police_report: filed; other driver's insurance info documented
